dsparkDescription: O laisolola DSpark Q8_0 molekane ({{size}}) ka gonne LFM2.5-2.6B. E ka nna ya potlakisa tlhagiso, mme e dirisa e e oketsegileng RAM kgotsa VRAM, go tlogela memori o monnye wa bokao. E leke mo serweboleteng sa gago; fetola boleele jwa bokao kgotsa thibela go tlhalosa dikhoutu ka go fopholetsa mo dipeakanyong tsa sekao.
